# Dirk Lubèrth Dijkman: home automation projects

> Open-source home automation projects by Dirk Lubèrth Dijkman, a maker from the Netherlands. The main project is Tasmota Scan & Control, a free Android app for Tasmota (and, new, Shelly) Wi-Fi switches. Made together with Claude Opus 5.5.

## Tasmota Scan & Control (main project)

Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) Android app to find, switch and schedule Tasmota Wi-Fi switches, plugs and lamps on your own network. No cloud, no account, no ads, no device limit. Timers run in the switch itself, with sunrise and sunset. Groups, scenes, widgets, wall panel mode, remote control with Tailscale VPN. New and untested on real hardware: basic Shelly support (scan, on/off, rename, auto-off, add a new Shelly).

- [Full llms.txt for the app](https://ldijkman.github.io/Tasmota-android-test/llms.txt): all features, facts and video links
- [Website](https://ldijkman.github.io/Tasmota-android-test/)
- [Live demo](https://ldijkman.github.io/Tasmota-android-test/demo/)
- [Source code and readme](https://github.com/ldijkman/Tasmota-android-test)
- [Download the latest APK](https://github.com/ldijkman/Tasmota-android-test/releases/latest/download/PlafondLED.apk)

## Electra

An ESP8266 Wi-Fi relay with a TFT touch screen and mDNS, for timed lights and automatic garden watering. Hardware design on EasyEDA / OSHWLab. Electra switches mains voltage: handle it with care.

- [Electra web page](https://ldijkman.github.io/randomnerd_esp32_wifi_manager/Touch_Electra-Electra_Touch/)
- [Hardware on OSHWLab](https://oshwlab.com/l.dijkman/Electra)
- [Electra overview](https://ldijkman.github.io/electra.html)
